name: baby-blue-slime-rest-prevents-next-2-combat-damage-to-other-slime
notes: Baby Blue Slime (9ggfiy38t2, WATER ALLY, TAMER/ANIMAL/SLIME, reserve 2, POWER 1 / LIFE 2): "[Class Bonus] CARDNAME gets +1 LIFE. [REST]: Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to another target Slime ally you control this turn." Baby Blue Slime is played for real from hand (FSM play + 2 reserve payments); WATER is unlocked by patching a Nico lineage into the champion and the deck is colorless so no fast-spell windows interrupt the flow. FIXED ENGINE BUG context: the REST body used to be registered in $cardActivatedAbilities (the play-effect dictionary) with a 0 ability count, so merely PLAYING Baby Blue Slime queued a free target prompt (no REST paid) and the ability could never be activated later; it is now a real $activateAbilityAbilities["9ggfiy38t2:0"] with a prereq and the ally auto-rest as the [REST] cost. Core use: after playing it (no on-enter prompt appears, nothing is rested or shielded), player 1 ends the turn and player 2 attacks Red Slime (LIFE 2) with a Dungeon Guide carrying two buff counters (POWER 3). In the attack priority window the "@Activate-0@Prevent" choice is listed for Baby Blue Slime; activating it rests Baby Blue Slime and shields Red Slime, so the 3 combat damage is reduced by exactly the prevented 2: Red Slime takes 1 and survives (unprevented it would have taken 3 and died).

rulesClauses: [REST]: Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to another target Slime ally you control this turn.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Baby Blue Slime's [REST] ability was registered in $cardActivatedAbilities (the play-effect dictionary) with a 0 $CardActivateAbilityCountData row instead of $activateAbilityAbilities: playing the ally auto-fired the 'prevent the next 2 damage' target prompt on enter without paying [REST], and the ability could never be activated from the field afterwards (the old CustomInput routing sent it through ActivateCard()). Fix: a real $activateAbilityAbilities["9ggfiy38t2:0"] + $activateAbilityPrereqs (ready + another Slime ally under your control) + "9ggfiy38t2:0:ActivateAbility-1" handler, ability count/name rows via GAActivateAbilityCountOverrides()/GAApplyActivateAbilityCountOverrides(), and the misfiled $cardActivatedAbilities body neutralized in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php new $activateAbilityAbilities/$activateAbilityPrereqs["9ggfiy38t2:0"] + GAActivateAbilityCountOverrides(); Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php ($cardActivatedAbilities no-op + count rows); Custom/OpportunityLogic.php GetPlayableFastAbilities()
